# vergeio_networks (Data Source)

Network data source schema

## Example Usage

```terraform



# Networks data source fetches the Network from the VergeIO.

data "vergeio_networks" "all" {
}
output "networks" {
  value = data.vergeio_networks.all.networks
}

# Add a filter to see information on a specific network

data "vergeio_networks" "all" {
  filter_name = "External"
}
output "networks" {
  value = data.vergeio_networks.all.networks
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Filter by name
- `filter_type` (String) Filter by type

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) List of Networks (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
